title: Jesus... Why Couldn't I Answer When She Asked If You're Real?
topic: not knowing how to answer a friend who asks if God is real

bible.text: Then Jesus told him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... my friend asked me how I know You're real. Why couldn't I answer her?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I just laughed and changed the topic. Then I lay awake wondering if I even know.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Not having the words ready doesn't mean you don't have Me.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But she had so many reasons. I only had a feeling. And feelings change.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Thomas had questions too. He wanted to see My hands. I didn't send him away. I came back for him.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: You showed him. You're not showing me. I can't see anything. 😔

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Look back at the nights you made it through. The prayer someone prayed for you when you couldn't. You've seen more of Me than you think.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You don't need every answer tonight. You can tell her the truth. You're still searching, and I haven't left.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: When was the last time you felt sure God was real? 🙏
